ns2:course.label: Seminar in Modern Art
ns2:course.description: Investigation of special problems in the history of twentieth-century art. Students present reports of their research. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. May be repeated to a maximum of 12 hours. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
